mapper.insert: INSERT INTO token_usage_daily (tenant_id, usage_date, model_provider, model_name, model_type, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, request_count, success_count, total_latency_ms) VALUES (#{usage.tenantId}, #{usage.usageDate}, #{usage.modelProvider}, #{usage.modelName}, 'CHAT', #{usage.promptTokens}, #{usage.completionTokens}, #{usage.totalTokens}, #{usage.requestCount}, #{usage.successCount}, #{usage.totalLatencyMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE prompt_tokens = COALESCE(prompt_tokens, 0) + VALUES(prompt_tokens), completion_tokens = COALESCE(completion_tokens, 0) + VALUES(completion_tokens), total_tokens = COALESCE(total_tokens, 0) + VALUES(total_tokens), request_count = COALESCE(request_count, 0) + VALUES(request_count), success_count = COALESCE(success_count, 0) + VALUES(success_count), total_latency_ms = COALESCE(total_latency_ms, 0) + VALUES(total_latency_ms), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
